Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Diff shape — right.** One file, `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`, +2/−2: lines 205–206 of the `retiredFromLoadPath` / `retiredAfter` checklist item rewritten in place. With those two lines removed from both sides the base and head files are byte-identical, so nothing else in the file moved, joined or re-wrapped. No accept-set changes (no schema, no runtime, no generated baseline) and no public surface: the file is seat-read tooling that ships in no package.
- **The sentence against the landed `retiredAfter` TSDoc (`719183f50`, an ancestor of `origin/main`; read verbatim on `origin/main`) — right, no rule of its own.**
  - General clause: TSDoc "the newest stable release at the moment the retirement lands, read off the package's version label" ↔ playbook "新退役填落地时最新 stable 发布". Same value, same moment.
  - Prerelease arm: TSDoc "never the label (not a stable `x.y.z`) and never `x.y.z`, the first stable release that carries the entry retired (`17.7.0` under `18.0.0-next.N`, say)" ↔ playbook "标签为 `x.y.z-next.N` 时永不填它或 `x.y.z`". The two forbidden values are the TSDoc's two; the value TO stamp (the newest published stable release) comes from the general clause, exactly as it does in the TSDoc's first paragraph.
  - Stable arm: TSDoc "it is the label itself" is not restated. Under a stable label the general clause already yields the label (`main` carries the last release's label until the next release is cut), and the census's `unpublishedStampProblem` takes exactly the label once that release is censused (between a bump and a census refresh it admits the closed range from the last censused release up to the label) — so the omission adds no rule and loses no value. The old sentence's "`packages/spec/package.json` 的当前版本标签" pointer is gone: that pointer is exactly the wrong instruction under a prerelease label, which is the defect this card exists for; `TSDoc 为准` now names where the full text lives.
  - "`TSDoc 为准`" is a pointer to the authority, not a rule. Every other clause traces to a TSDoc sentence. The triage direction (restate the landed text, no new words) and the unlock direction (no restated rule of its own) hold.
  - One narrowing of spelling, judged acceptable and flagged under ③: the playbook writes the arm's trigger as `x.y.z-next.N` (the TSDoc's own example and the current `.changeset/pre.json` tag) where the TSDoc writes `x.y.z-PRERELEASE`.
- **An AI author following the playbook stamps a value tsc and the census accept — right.** Today `packages/spec/package.json` reads `17.7.0` (stable) and `.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, `tag: next`. Once the Version Packages pass writes `18.0.0-next.N`, the author reads "newest stable release at landing, never the label, never `18.0.0`" and stamps `17.7.0` (or a later `17.x` maintenance release if one is published first): it matches tsc's `${number}.${number}.${number}` template, and the census's prerelease branch accepts any `v` in `[last censused release, 18.0.0)`. Under the stable label as it stands today the author stamps `17.7.0`, which equals the label, and the census's stable branch accepts exactly that. The old sentence would have handed the author `18.0.0-next.N`, which both refuse.
- **The parenthetical still carries both pointers — right.** "`retired-after.census.test.ts` 逐值钉" (the census pin) and "artifact 门据它逐条开窗" (the artifact-door pointer) are carried verbatim from the old sentence, in the same parenthetical.
- **Line ratchet — right.** 337 lines before and after against the CEILINGS row `['.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md', 337]`. Rewritten lines measure 118 and 117 bytes (base 116 and 76 by my byte count; the PR body says 119 and 73 — same 192-byte total, immaterial), both within the 120-byte budget. Widest table row unchanged at 324 bytes (line 86; pin 326). Zero raw control bytes in the head file. CI's `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (the job that runs `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `lint.yml:1016`) is green on this head.
- **Commit and PR body — right.** The head commit carries the session-URL trailer and a model-free `Co-authored-by` trailer; its claim "line count unchanged (337)" is true. The PR body's two TSDoc quotations match the landed text word for word, its "Before" block matches the base lines, and `Fixes #23057` plus `Clause-②: no` are present. The head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (not a fork).

### ② Semver level

- **`skip-changeset` — right.** The diff publishes nothing: `.claude/**` is repo-root seat tooling, no `packages/*/package.json` references it, and the published skill catalog (`skills/**`) is untouched. `Check Changeset` is green with the label.
- **`Clause-②: no` — right.** No ADR-0087 conversion entry, no authorable surface, no changeset body; `no` with no arm is the correct declaration and the PR body carries it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev deviations (4), each answered.** (1) Two pushes, the empty-branch write probe then the commit: as os-dev rule 1 asks; fine. (2) `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite build missing) and was re-run after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` locally: a local-environment matter only; CI's own `Lint · docs & code guards` is the verdict of record here. (3) The pointer is the unqualified `TSDoc 为准` because `以其 TSDoc 为准` overran 120 bytes: accepted — the bolded `retiredAfter` key at the head of the same item fixes the referent. (My count makes the longer form 124 bytes, not 121; either way over budget.) (4) Attribution trailers follow AGENTS.md's model-free form: fine.
- **`open_questions`: none.** Nothing to answer or escalate.
- **`out_of_scope_findings` (1) — correctly out.** The ratchet's info line reporting 2 bytes of `max-table-row-bytes` headroom (widest 324, pin 326) is a condition of the base `02bec6ca8`, not of this diff; lowering the pin edits `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, outside this card's declared file surface; the ratchet is shrink-only and the line is advisory. Carried as `承接者:无` in the PR's Acceptance notes, which is the shape os-dev.md asks for when no carrier exists.
- **For the maintainer, no action owed before landing:**
  - The prerelease arm is spelled `x.y.z-next.N`, narrower than the TSDoc's `x.y.z-PRERELEASE`. It is right for the current `next` tag and the stamped value is the same under any tag (the general clause gives it, and the census's `releaseTriple` drops any suffix), but should the pre tag ever change (this file itself cites `17.0.0-rc.0` at line 198) the explicit arm would not name that label — the general clause and the TSDoc pointer still would.
  - The PR body's `维护者速读(草稿)` has an empty `席位意见:` bullet; the owning seat fills or drops it when it lands the PR.
  - Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-10-13T05:00Z after the last in-progress run (`Test Core (1/6)`) completed: 43 runs, all completed — 32 success, 11 skipped (path-filtered battery: Build Core, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood matrix, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, and the second `Check Changeset` / `Auto Label` / `Check PR Size` instances), 0 failure, 0 in progress. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, all six `Test Core` shards and every type-check job are green.
